$comment: The design system is authored in telecraft-dev/telecraft and copied here.
ADR-0047's consequences call this dependency 'a versioned release, not a
copy'. The scheme now exists — telecraft ADR-0049 defines vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
tags and ships the design system as an archive — but no tag has been cut,
so there is still nothing to depend on. Point `ref` at the release tag the
moment one exists (telecraft-dev/telecraft#86). Until then these are
copies with their provenance written down and a check that fails when they
drift. That is the honest description of them, and calling them anything
`ref` is what the copies were taken from and `commit` is what that ref
resolved to, because a branch moves and a commit does not. While `ref`
names anything other than main, `tools/vendor.mjs check` reports the
difference against main instead of failing on it: a copy of an unmerged
branch is supposed to differ from main. Point `ref` back at main — or at
whatever #86 decides — the moment the source lands, and drift is fatal
interim: telecraft-dev/telecraft#93 is open and unmerged; the tagging scheme this should become is telecraft-dev/telecraft#86
